title: 2193. Set Operations on Two Groups of Numbers
description:

Set Operations on Two Groups of Numbers
60
Medium
Problem Statement
Read two groups of integers, A and B, and print their union, their intersection and the numbers that are in A but not in B.
Description
Two groups of integers, A and B, are given. A number may be repeated inside a group, but each group must be treated as a set. Print the union of A and B, the intersection of A and B, and the difference A - B (the numbers that are in A but not in B). Print every result in increasing order.
Input Description
Two lines. The first line contains the integers of group A and the second line contains the integers of group B, separated by single spaces. (Each group has 1 to 20 integers, each between -100 and 100)
Output Description
Print 3 lines: the union, the intersection and the difference A - B. Print each result as a list in square brackets, in increasing order, with the numbers separated by a comma and a space, for example [1, 2, 3]. If a result has no numbers, print [].
Sample Input
1 2 3 4
3 4 5 6
Sample Output
[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
[3, 4]
[1, 2]
